meta.name: update-skills
meta.description: Re-apply your installed skills to pull their latest code from upstream.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重新应用已安装的技能以拉取最新代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已安装多个技能并希望保持它们最新
copy.tagline_en: Re-apply installed skills to pull their latest code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have installed skills and want to keep them up-to-date

howto.what: 运行后，Claude Code 会检查已安装的渠道/提供方技能，列出可更新的选项让你挑选。选中的技能会重新执行各自的安装步骤，从上游拉取最新代码覆盖本地，再运行构建与测试验证。
howto.when: 当你在 Claude Code 中发起 /update-skills 命令时触发。若没有已安装的代码型技能，会提示无需更新。

say.text: 运行 /update-skills 更新所有已安装的技能
重新应用 Discord 技能并跳过其他
say.note: 在多选界面只勾选 Discord

howto.what_en: Running /update-skills checks installed channel/provider skills, lets you pick which to re-apply, re-runs each skill's own install step to fetch latest code from upstream, then validates with build and test.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you run /update-skills in Claude Code. If no code-carrying skills are installed, it tells you none need updating.

say_en.text: Run /update-skills to update all installed skills
say_en.note: Shows a list for you to select

say_en.text: Re-apply Discord and skip the rest
say_en.note: Only select Discord in the multi-select
